result.title: Zeroth-Order Policy Optimization for Scheduling in Queueing Networks
result.summary: Reinforcement learning in queueing network scheduling presents significant challenges because of the countably infinite state space and the high stochasticity in transitions. In this paper, we propose zeroth-order policy optimization algorithms that are easy to implement and rely solely on estimates of the average cost, a single scalar quantity, without requiring the estimation of value or advantage functions. Our analysis focuses on back-pressure guarded policies and establishes uniform smoothness of the average cost objective with respect to the policy parameters. Building on this property, we establish finite-time convergence guarantees to an $ε$-stationary policy for the proposed algorithms. Numerical experiments on multiple queueing networks, including systems beyond classical exponential service distribution, demonstrate competitive performance, outperforming gradient-based RL methods like PPO and traditional queueing baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对排队网络调度，提出仅依赖平均代价这一标量估计、无需价值或优势函数的零阶策略优化算法，对 back-pressure guard 策略证明平均代价目标的均匀光滑性并给出有限时间收敛到 ε-稳定策略的保证，实验优于 PPO 等基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉多模态推理无直接关系，但「只用标量代价、免价值函数」的零阶优化思路可能为 latent 推理轨迹中贡献分配与监督信号不足时的参数优化提供参考，可供核查其是否适用于不可微 latent 状态的训练。
